mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over the past 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the past three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals a contraction in household demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annual inflation rate above 3.0% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) signals an inflationary environment that triggers central bank tightening, reducing real equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annual change exceeds 3.0%, the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with a weakening labor market, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market weakness
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and decline in PAYEMS does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars), retail sales growth accelerates, boosting corporate revenue and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 700,000 million dollars, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO increases, the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
